QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: Other Investment Products_12

question.text: Under the Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS), the maximum investment for a single account is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, the maximum investment in POMIS for a singly held account is Rs.4.5 lakh, while a jointly held account allows up to Rs.9 lakh. The Trap: Rs.9 lakh is the joint-account limit and is a frequent distractor for the single-account question. Note: Scheme limits may have been revised by the post office over time; for client conversations always verify the current operative limit before relying on the workbook figure.
